p:cNvPr.descr: Image (a) begins with palmitoyl-CoA, where (C16) R bonds right to CH2, which bonds right to beta over CH2, which bonds right to alpha over CH2. Alpha over CH2 bonds right to C, which double bonds down to O (all in pink). C also bonds right to S-CoA. Below this is an arrow pointing down, represented as acyl-CoA dehydrogenase. To the right of the arrow is a curved arrow pointing from FAD to FADH2, and another curved arrow points from FADH2 back to FAD. Next is trans- delta2-enoyl-CoA, which begins with R bonding right to CH2, which bonds right to C, which bonds up to H and double bonds right to C. C bonds down to H and right to C, which double bonds down to O (all in a pink box). C also bonds right to S-CoA. Below this is an arrow pointing down to L-beta-hydroxyacyl-CoA, represented as enoyl-CoA hydratase. H2O feeds into this arrow. L-beta-hydroxyacyl-CoA begins with R, which bonds right to CH2, which bonds right to C, which bonds up to OH, down to H, and right to CH2 (pink). CH2 bonds right to C, which double bonds down to O (all in pink). C also bonds right to S-CoA. Below this is an arrow pointing down to beta-ketoacyl-CoA, represented as beta-hydroxyacyl-CoA dehydrogenase (in blue). To the right of the arrow is a curved arrow pointing from NAD+ to NADH [plus] H+, which also has a curved arrow pointing back up to NAD+. Beta-ketoacyl-CoA begins with R bonding right to CH2, which bonds right to C, which double bonds down to O, which bonds right to CH2 (pink). CH2 bonds right to C, which double bonds down to O (all in a pink box). C also bonds right to S-CoA. Below this is an arrow pointing to acyl-CoA (myristoyl-CoA), represented as acyl-CoA acetyltransferase (thiolase) (in blue). CoA-SH merges into this arrow. Acyl-CoA (myristoyl-CoA) begins with (C14) R, which bonds right to CH2, which bonds right to C, which double bonds down to O and bonds right to S-CoA [plus] CH3 bonds right to C, which double bonds down to O (all in pink), and also bonds right to S-CoA. Below this Acetyl (in pink box)-CoA is positioned under the pink portion of acetyl-CoA. To the right of this process is a red arrow coming from the FAD/FADH2 exchange pointing to ETF. On this arrow is 2e-. ETF points to another red arrow, which points to another red arrow pointing to respiratory chain (in blue box). A red arrow comes up to point to that same box by NADH dehydrogenase. Another red arrow points to NADH dehydrogenase from the NAD+/NADH [plus] H+ exchange. On that arrow is 2 e-.
